summary.text: Bryan Breitling is an independent candidate for South Dakota State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Bart Sample (R).
Breitling, a health care administrator, represented District 23 in the State Senate as a Republican from 2021 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Breitling was born in Hoven, South Dakota, and graduated from Roscoe High School.

He served in the U.S. Army National Guard for 11 years, earned a business degree from Northern State University and a master's degree in health care administration from the University of Sioux Falls, and worked as a health care administrator.
Breitling won the South Dakota State Senate District 23 seat in the 2020 general election, defeating CJ Abernathey (L).
He won re-election in 2022 after defeating Spencer Gosch in the Republican primary, and he served as vice chair of the Senate Appropriations Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
He did not file for re-election in 2024 and left office on January 14, 2025.
